_what: Every check for curation/li_39883839, with numbers. Each metric has a seeded counterpart that was confirmed to MOVE it; 'an exception was raised' is not the bar (three ZT_2026 checks scored a literal 0 for twelve days while the summary said ALL FOUR EXACT).

counts.library_grid: 9 head groups x 4 tail A x 4 tail B
counts.library_members_with_a_per_member_delive: The 144 were screened POOLED -- 16 LNPs per mouse in batch 1, 4 per mouse in batch 2. Only lipids promoted out of the pools were ever injected alone.

P1_tableS1_formula.what: Each of the 144 enumerated library structures vs the molecular formula Table S1 prints for that name. External to the enumeration: the formula is the authors', the structure ours.

P1b_tableS1_self_consistency.what: A check on the PAPER alone -- it uses no structure of ours. It separates 'our structure is wrong' from 'their table is wrong' for every P1 mismatch.

P1c_mismatch_diagnosis.what: If the two multisets are identical the printed cells are the RIGHT values on the WRONG names -- a row-alignment slip in the table, not a missing or extra composition.

P4_reagent_stoichiometry.what: mg / umol is the authors' own number pair and is independent of the reagent NAME printed beside it. This is what settles the A4B4-S3/S4 aldehyde against a wrong printed name.

P5_block_MS.what: The SI labels these '(M + H+)' but the numbers are the NEUTRAL monoisotopic masses. Testing both readings is the point: one of them fits 8/9 and the other fits none.

P6_lipid_MS.what: The SI uses TWO mass conventions without saying so: average [M+H]+ for the four H2A4* lipids, monoisotopic [M+H]+ for A4B4-S3/S4. Checked against only one, four or two of six would look wrong.

P7_distinct_structures.what: Trap 1 of the brief. The paper's own count of what it made is 144 + 4; two of those names are ONE molecule.

same_lab_in_corpus.note: Three Bowen Li experiments are already in the corpus. None is PMID 39883839. The Ugi 3CR paper is this paper's own ref 1 and is the closest relative: a different multicomponent reaction giving an alpha-AMINO amide, not an alpha-ACYLOXY amide.

P8_corpus_overlap.what: Three comparisons -- full InChIKey, skeleton InChIKey, IL_name -- across both pools. Zero on all six.

P9_axis_calibration.what: Scale AND origin fitted together on detected tick positions only (axis.calibrate has no API for supplying an origin -- F-033). Fig 2K's 4e7 tick is drawn short at the axis break, so it is VERIFIED against the fit rather than fed into it.

P10_bar_detection.what: bars.bar_top requires full-width coverage plus left/right flank agreement, so a centred replicate marker cannot be read as a top (error class 32, F-018/F-020). Every flank delta here is 0.0 px. Three refusals were kept as refusals and turned into bounds, not argued down by lowering a threshold (F-018, F-051).

V1_fig3H_printed_ROI_containment.legibility: leading digit and exponent legible; 2nd-4th mantissa digits are not resolvable at the embedded resolution (~1 px per stroke). Read as 3.0e7 / 1.7e8 / 4.1e7 with an uncertainty of about +/-0.1 in the leading decimal.
V1_fig3H_printed_ROI_containment.what: A number the authors DREW on the image and never discussed, external to our calibration. Each is one representative mouse, so the test is containment in the group's drawn spread -- NOT equality with the n=3 bar mean.

V2_H2A4B4_two_panels.what: Independent panels, independent tick sets, independent calibrations, one lipid at one dose and route. NOTE: this is NOT evidence for panel K's linear axis -- the linear reading was already forced by panel K's own four equally spaced labelled ticks and verified by its 4e7 short tick. It is a check on the two digitisations given that scale.

V3_same_molecule_two_names.what: H2A4-Ole and H2A4B2 have the same full InChIKey. On Fig 2H the bar has no resolvable height; on Fig 2K it is the second smallest bar. Both say 'at the floor', which is as much agreement as either panel can express.

V4_fig2H_vs_fig2K.what: Both panels state 0.05 mg/kg mLuc, I.M., 6 h. The same two lipids differ by 2.8x and 25.8x between them, in the same direction, so the panels are different cohorts on different effective scales and must NOT share a z-score block without a decision. This is DECISIONS D-1.

V5_molar_percent_sum.what: The Methods print the ratio 50:10:38.5:1.5 and never say it is a mole-percent set. It sums to exactly 100, which fixes the formulation columns without a further assumption.

V6_batch_dose.what: Batch 1 pooled 16 LNPs per mouse and batch 2 pooled 4. The caption's two doses give EXACTLY the same per-LNP dose (0.02 mg/kg each); the Methods' two give 0.0156 and 0.200, a 12.8x spread. A screen that changes the per-LNP dose 13-fold between rounds cannot compare them, so the caption is the self-consistent pair. No row is emitted from either batch (both are pooled mixtures), so this adjudicates a recorded contradiction, not a value.

C10_anchors.route: plain string substitution into one head-first template; no assemble/RWMol/AddBond/RemoveAtom/atom-map shared with stage02_enumerate.py

seeded_connectivity_swap.what: head acid amidated and the isocyanide alkyl esterified -- the Passerini run backwards

C10_anchors.what: C16 exists because C10's independence was asserted twice and false twice. The seeded connectivity swap has the SAME molecular formula and the SAME exact mass to 4 dp as the correct structure and a different InChIKey -- which is the whole argument for an anchor, and the measurement that shows this one has teeth.
